notes_for_review: Large benchmark (over 2,600 scored edit processes, five LLM editors) of LLM agents editing vision classifiers through a budgeted tool server, plus a training method (ERT) that rehearses the closed-form rank-one head edits the agents were observed to make. The key descriptive finding is that LLM edits reduce to sparse rank-one re-routing of the classifier head along a support-vs-reference feature contrast, i.e. a mechanical closed-form edit; yet the paper does not directly compare the LLM against applying that closed-form rule itself on the same requests. Statistics are paired sign-flip tests with bootstrap intervals; code and transcripts are promised, not yet released.
